The email API that lands in the inbox, not spam.

Sendwell is an email API for developers. Send password resets, receipts and alerts from your app with a few lines of code, and get them delivered in under two seconds.

Get a free API keyRead the docs
npm install sendwell
import { Sendwell } from "sendwell";

const mail = new Sendwell(process.env.SENDWELL_KEY);

await mail.send({
  from: "hello@yourapp.com",
  to: "sam@example.com",
  template: "welcome",
  data: { name: "Sam" }
});
from sendwell import Sendwell

mail = Sendwell(os.environ["SENDWELL_KEY"])

mail.send(
    from_="hello@yourapp.com",
    to="sam@example.com",
    template="welcome",
    data={"name": "Sam"},
)
curl https://api.sendwell.example/v1/send \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SENDWELL_KEY" \
  -d '{"from":"hello@yourapp.com",
       "to":"sam@example.com",
       "template":"welcome",
       "data":{"name":"Sam"}}'
✓ 202 Accepted · delivered to inbox in 1.3s

// features

Everything you need to send email from code.

Stop fighting spam filters and SMTP settings. Sendwell handles delivery, so you can ship your product.

Fast delivery

Median time to inbox of 1.3 seconds, from data centres in the US, EU and Asia.

Email templates

Design templates in HTML or our editor, then send with template: "welcome".

Webhooks

Get instant events for delivered, opened, clicked, bounced and complained.

Domain setup in minutes

We check your DNS and tell you exactly which SPF, DKIM and DMARC records to add.

Logs you can search

Find any email by address or ID and see exactly what happened, for 30 days.

Test mode

Use your test key to send to a safe sandbox inbox while you build.

// faq

Questions developers ask.

What is a transactional email API?

A transactional email API lets your app send automatic emails, like sign-up confirmations, password resets and receipts, with a simple web request instead of running your own mail server.

How do I stop my emails going to spam?

Verify your domain with SPF, DKIM and DMARC records, send from a real address and keep your lists clean. Sendwell checks your setup and tells you exactly what to fix.

Can I send marketing emails too?

Sendwell is built for emails your app sends one at a time. For newsletters, use our separate Broadcasts feature so your transactional mail stays fast.

Is there a free plan?

Yes. Send up to 3,000 emails a month free, forever, with no credit card.

# Developer Api

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/saas-landing/developer-api/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
